title: Onions +116%. EMI next? India CPI hit 6.09% — RBI red line crossed #Shorts
description:
India's October CPI came in at 6.09% — the first time it's crossed RBI's 6% upper band since October 2024.

Food inflation is at 8.94%, onion prices are up 116% year-on-year, and the RBI's repo rate is already at 5.50%.

The MPC meets December 2–4. Most analysts expect one more 25 bps rate hike, which would push home loan EMIs higher again.

Will the RBI hike in December? Drop a Yes or No in the comments 👇
